title: 第9章 王飞宇的歹毒计划第10章 药材被毁陆成的反击
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
翌日。
陆成处理完废丹后便来到了补天峰，墨尘居身为三品炼丹师，拥有独立的山峰。
山峰上开垦了很多药田，种满了很多珍贵的药材。
陆成深呼吸一口气，爬到山顶，整理了一下衣袍，正准备敲门，石门自己打开。
院内的空间很宽敞，足足比他的废丹院大了数十倍。
院子中央放着一座一米多高的黄铜丹炉，炉身刻满了复杂的纹路，下方连接着地脉火口，隐隐有红火色光芒透出。
看到黄铜丹炉的刹那，陆成不由自主地摸了摸储物袋，他的那个神秘破碗。
若是拥有像院中炼丹炉下方的三足和炉鼎的两耳的话，倒是挺像一个缩小版的炼丹炉。
院子东侧有一座大殿，殿内极为敞亮。
墨尘居端坐于高位，下方坐着上百位弟子，是昨天通过第一轮考核的。
陆成走至大殿门口，认出其中有几人是昨天出言嘲讽他的人。
陆成双手一拜，道：“弟子陆成，前来报到，因身处废丹院，需要焚烧废丹，所以……”
墨尘居没有看向陆成，双目微闭，声音平淡道：“坐下，仔细聆听。”
“是。”陆成走到一个地方坐下。
这时，他旁边的王飞宇眉头一皱，脸上露出嫌弃的表情，伸出手扇着鼻前空气，冷不丁地来句：“难闻死了，去那边坐着去！！”
陆成眉头微皱，他身处废丹院，身上难免会沾染到废丹的霉味和恶臭味，可他来之前已清洗数遍，身上再三确信没有一丝味道。
而旁边的这位王飞宇，反应未免也太大了些，这简直就是赤裸裸的羞辱他了。
陆成正要开口，墨尘居开口道：“王飞宇，肃静，莫生事端，否则哪怕你是王长老的孙子，你也给老夫滚出去，我这里容不下你尊大佛！”
王飞宇欲言又止，最终还是闭嘴，只不过看向陆成的目光，充满了厌恶。
陆成将王飞宇的神情尽收眼底，认出他正是昨日嘲讽自己、在自己通过第一道考核后又被其他同门嘲笑的人。

而墨尘居口中的王长老则是青玄宗内门长老，王厉，筑基大圆满！
陆成眼神微微一沉，他不想惹事，但若是有人故意找茬，那他可不会心慈手软，不介意替王厉管教一下他的孙子！
这王飞宇穿着一看就是生活极其讲究的人，他腰间挂着美玉，身材欣长，一双白手套，一尘不染！
似是因为陆成身上的气味污染到了他周围的空气，他手上的白手套也脏了，他又从储物袋里拿出一副白手套，换上。
陆成：“……”
这洁癖的有点过分了吧！
这时，墨尘居开口道：“你们对炼丹之道都有不错的理解，但是缺少真正的上手，接下来，我会亲自演练一遍，你们观摩我炼丹过程，事后我会给你们分配丹房，让你们亲自上手炼丹开始第二轮考核，若有我的允许，不得私自引动地火，明白吗？”
“是，弟子明白。”陆成和其他人异口同声道。
墨尘居睁开双目，目光在陆成身上停留一秒便收回，带领弟子来到院内。
他伸手，掌心瞬间出现一道烈火，将其引入炼丹炉内，紧跟着便有丹童端着药材走到他面前。
墨尘居将七星草扔进炼丹炉内，七星草在炼丹炉内发出噼里啪啦的声音。
墨尘居道：“七星草是炼制筑基丹的药材之一，炼制时火焰温度必须精准地控制在300摄氏度，提纯比例……”
他站在炼丹炉前，将炼制夺灵丹的六种药材相继放入炼丹炉，一边炼化，一边讲解每一株药材的提纯程度，以及火焰控制的温度，过程极其详细。
陆成眼睛一眨不眨，死死盯着墨尘居所有的动作和药材的变化。
墨尘居拿起一株通体雪白的“玄参草”，投入炼丹炉中。
玄参草在炉火中缓缓融化，化作一滩雪白色的灵液。
content_en:
The next day.
After Lu Cheng finished processing the waste pills, he came to Butian Peak. Mo Chenju, as a third-grade alchemist, had an independent mountain peak.
Many medicinal fields have been cultivated on the mountain peaks and planted with many precious medicinal materials.
Lu Cheng took a deep breath, climbed to the top of the mountain, straightened his robes, and was about to knock on the door when the stone door opened by itself.
The space inside the courtyard is very spacious, dozens of times larger than his Waste Pill Institute.
In the center of the yard stood a brass alchemy furnace over one meter high. The furnace body was engraved with complex patterns. The lower part was connected to the earth vein fire port, and there was a faint red light coming out.
The moment he saw the brass alchemy furnace, Lu Cheng couldn't help but touch the storage bag for his mysterious broken bowl.
If it had the three legs and the two ears of the cauldron under the alchemy furnace in the courtyard, it would look like a smaller version of the alchemy furnace.
There is a large hall on the east side of the courtyard, which is extremely bright.
Mo Chenju was sitting in a high position, with hundreds of disciples sitting below him, who had passed the first round of assessment yesterday.
Lu Cheng walked to the entrance of the hall and recognized several of the people who had mocked him yesterday.
Lu Cheng bowed his hands and said: "Disciple Lu Cheng, come here to report. Because you are in the waste elixir courtyard, you need to burn the waste elixir, so..."
Mo Chenju didn't look at Lu Cheng. He closed his eyes slightly and said in a calm voice: "Sit down and listen carefully."
"Yes." Lu Cheng walked to a place and sat down.
At this time, Wang Feiyu, who was next to him, frowned, with a look of disgust on his face, stretched out his hand to fan the air in front of his nose, and said abruptly: "It smells terrible, go and sit over there!!"
Lu Cheng frowned slightly. He was in the waste elixir courtyard, and his body would inevitably be contaminated with the musty and stench of waste elixir. However, he had washed it several times before coming here, and he was sure there was no smell on his body.
The Wang Feiyu next to him reacted too much, which was a naked humiliation to him.
Just as Lu Cheng was about to speak, Mo Chenju said: "Wang Feiyu, be quiet and don't cause trouble. Otherwise, even if you are the grandson of Elder Wang, get out of here. I can't tolerate you worshiping the Buddha here!"
Wang Feiyu hesitated to speak, and finally shut up, but looked at Lu Cheng with eyes full of disgust.
Lu Cheng took in Wang Feiyu's expression and recognized him as the man who mocked him yesterday and was ridiculed by his fellow students after he passed the first test.
And the elder Wang that Mo Chenju mentioned was the elder of the inner sect of Qingxuan Sect, Wang Li, Foundation Establishment Great Perfection!
Lu Cheng's eyes darkened slightly. He didn't want to cause trouble, but if someone deliberately sought trouble, he would not be merciful and would not mind disciplining his grandson for Wang Li!
Wang Feiyu is dressed like a man who lives an extremely elegant life. He has beautiful jade hanging around his waist, a long figure, and a pair of white gloves that are spotless!
It seemed that the smell of Lu Cheng's body had polluted the air around him, and the white gloves on his hands were also dirty. He took out another pair of white gloves from his storage bag and put them on.
Lu Cheng: "..."
This mysophobia is a bit too much!
At this time, Mo Chenju said: "You all have a good understanding of the method of alchemy, but you lack the real experience. Next, I will practice it myself. You will observe my alchemy process. Afterwards, I will assign an alchemy room to you and let you start the second round of assessment by refining the alchemy yourself. If you have my permission, you are not allowed to ignite the earth fire privately. Do you understand?"
"Yes, disciple understands." Lu Cheng and others said in unison.
Mo Chenju opened his eyes, his gaze lingered on Lu Cheng for a second and then he looked away, leading his disciples to the courtyard.
He stretched out his hand, and a blazing fire instantly appeared in his palm, leading it into the alchemy furnace. Immediately afterwards, an alchemist boy walked up to him carrying medicinal materials.
Mo Chenju threw the seven-star grass into the alchemy furnace, and the seven-star grass made a crackling sound in the alchemy furnace.
Mo Chenju said: "Seven-star grass is one of the medicinal materials for refining the Foundation Establishment Pill. During refining, the flame temperature must be accurately controlled at 300 degrees Celsius. The purification ratio..."
He is standing making alchemyIn front of the furnace, the six medicinal materials for refining the elixir were put into the alchemy furnace one after another. While refining, the purification degree of each medicinal material and the temperature of the flame control were explained in great detail.
Lu Cheng's eyes were unblinking, staring at all Mo Chenju's movements and the changes in the medicinal materials.
Mo Chenju picked up a snow-white "Scophyllum grass" and threw it into the alchemy furnace.
Scrophulariaceae slowly melted in the fire and turned into a pool of snow-white spiritual liquid.
